name: Hex: Plaything

description.content: The first time you hook each Survivor, they are hexed and a Dull Totem ignites.
For [90s], the Hex Totem is blocked to other Survivors.

items: Within [16m] of the Hex Totem, they see its Aura.

quote: "We came. Now you must come with us. Taste our pleasures." -Pinhead
